meta.notes: Discovered via `npm run discover:schema` + data profiling against devx-tsc (asia-south1). Orders: production.fact_order_item (line-item grain, 1,095,545 rows / 697,154 distinct orders, boolean is_cancelled/is_refunded flags, shipping_pincode 99.95% valid 6-digit). Leads: view_reports.lead_base (4,181,431 rows = 4,181,431 distinct phone, i.e. exactly one row per lead; partitioned on lead_created_on, clustered on source/quality/lead_type). Conversion is order-backed via phone join because lead_base carries no stage column. See config/schema.mapping.lsq-status.json for the CRM-stage alternative.
